name: Rhema Studio · Worship Expressions
author: Rhema Studio contributors
description: 120 portable design recipes: gradients, scripture/hymn/song layouts, transparent NDI/OBS overlays, lower thirds, news tickers, and camera/picture/video scene placeholders. No images or video are bundled.
